svg.title: Domain Agents, Virtual Roles and Shared Capabilities
svg.desc: Five outcome-owned domain agents arranged in a full-width matrix of Secretary, Coach, and Expert virtual roles. All domain responsibilities, representative Core Features, Feature Groups, New Agent Lens, New Leader Lens, Shared Skills and Authorized Tools from the supplied source are retained. Design Principles, the Orchestrator Agent, and its routing connections have been removed. The shared-capability connection from all five domains is retained. The five domain rows share #DC416A identification panels with white text and icons, white content areas with black text, #D31145 feature labels, and #F6CFDA borders and dividers. All other colors, content, icon geometry and the full-width layout are unchanged. The 5376 by 2560 canvas remains transparent.

text.data-label: Virtual roles combine by task; cells show representative Core Features.
